_about: The places of 徐 — a map, not a chain. `roads` go both ways; `tier` is the ladder index a place asks for (0 练气 … 8 渡劫), and a place above the player's tier is refused in the mist with a fitting place to go instead. `has` says what is there: a creature with its card, the province's seed pool, the market, a chapter scene. `line` is one sentence of what is there, for the director's brief.
_pools: 游荡的怪 (Hanli, 2026-10-05: 一片地方一个游荡怪物池，可重复打): a pool is a stretch of country's beasts and their weights; a place joins it by `has.pool` (world.mjs poolBeast). Only beasts of 卷一's book and a few added: 蒙山's are a hunter's trade (野猪 · 狼 · 熊), 狰 runs wild outside the herb garden, 蠪侄 in the wood outside the gate (古三), 蛫 by the Si (古五's 秘境).

line.zh: 泗水南岸，芦苇齐人高，你拾到铃的地方。
line.en: The south bank of the Si, reeds as tall as you — where you found the bell.

line.zh: 雾常年不散。往北一条土路，通冀州的漳水。
line.en: The mist never lifts. A dirt road runs north to the Zhang in Ji.

line.zh: 徐州的城，坊市在南门里。
line.en: The city of Xu; the market lies inside the south gate.

line.zh: 山形如卧龙，山上有石床，传说仙人在此醉卧。
line.en: A hill shaped like a sleeping dragon, a stone bed on top where an immortal is said to have slept off his wine.

line.zh: 一条船，一个老船家。渡人，不渡心事。
line.en: One boat, one old boatman. He carries people, not their troubles.

line.zh: 下邳的老桥。当年一位老人在桥上掉了鞋，一个少年替他拾了三次。
line.en: The old bridge at Xiapi. An old man once dropped his shoe here; a young man picked it up three times.

line.zh: 泗水入淮之处，两水相激，船家在此歇桨。
line.en: Where the Si meets the Huai; two waters collide, and boatmen rest their oars.

line.zh: 泗水最险的一段，石齿如林，水声如雷。
line.en: The wildest stretch of the Si: rocks like teeth, water like thunder.

line.zh: 大泽无边，芦苇里藏着走蛇的小路。
line.en: A marsh without edges; snake-paths hide in the reeds.

line.zh: 湖上千顷荷，湖心有岛，岛上有古墓。
line.en: A thousand acres of lotus; an island at the heart, and an old tomb on the island.

line.zh: 徐州得名之山，山顶终年有云。
line.en: The mountain the province is named for; clouds sit on its top all year.

line.zh: 大泽无边。西狩获麟的地方。
line.en: A marsh without end. Where the unicorn was taken in the western hunt.

line.zh: 山里有婴儿的哭声，不是婴儿。
line.en: In the hills a sound of infants crying. Not infants.

line.zh: 一株空心的桑树。伊尹生在这儿。
line.en: A hollow mulberry. Yi Yin was born here.

line.zh: 彭城下的深水，始皇的绳子在这里断过。
line.en: The deep water under Pengcheng, where the First Emperor's rope once broke.

line.zh: 渡叔的船拴在这里，一盏灯挂在桩上，大水天也不灭。
line.en: Du Shu's boat is tied here, a lantern on the post that stays lit even in the floods.

line.zh: 往沉鼎观的石径，沟深草密，三年一回挤满上山的孩子。
line.en: The stone path up to Chending Temple: deep ditches, thick grass, and once in three years, crowded with children climbing.

line.zh: 三百级石阶顶上一座旧山门，瞿老守在门里，谁进谁出都要过他那一关。
line.en: An old gate at the top of three hundred steps. Elder Qu keeps it; no one comes or goes without passing him.

line.zh: 正殿里没有神像，只有一口空的石座，四方，四足。
line.en: No statue in the main hall — only an empty stone seat, square, on four feet.

line.zh: 外门的院子：晒着的柴，井边的水桶，周衡的账本。
line.en: The outer court: firewood drying, buckets by the well, Zhou Heng's ledger.

keeper.en: the pedlar of the south road

line.zh: 蒙山脚下十七户人家，十六户种地，一户打猎——你家。
line.en: Seventeen households at the foot of Mount Meng: sixteen farm, one hunts — yours.

name.en: The front slopes of Mount Meng

line.zh: 马家的山。三场围猎把前山篦了一遍又一遍，满地狗爪印。
line.en: The Mas' mountain. Three autumn hunts combed the front slopes bare; dog tracks everywhere.

name.en: Black Pine Ridge · The broken stele

line.zh: 岭口的断碑，只剩两个字还看得清：勿入。
line.en: The broken stele at the ridge mouth; only two characters still read: Do not enter.

line.zh: 树比外面的高一倍，树皮黑得像铁；路会自己打结。
line.en: Trees twice as tall as outside, bark black as iron; the paths tie themselves in knots.

line.zh: 崖下的山谷，银叶树上挂着露珠，草叶踩下去会发亮。
line.en: The vale under the cliff: silver-leaved trees hung with dew, grass that glows where you step.

line.zh: 外门的讲堂：一排排矮桌，褚先生的山羊胡子一翘一翘。每日辰时上课。
line.en: The outer court's lecture hall: rows of low desks, and Master Chu's goat beard bobbing. Lessons every morning at the hour of the dragon.

line.zh: 藏经阁七层，外门弟子只许上三层。最顶层的门上一把铜锁，锁眼都绿了。你走近的时候，胸口的木牌烫了一下，一个很困的声音：「……九鼎……神丹……」然后就没声了。
line.en: Seven floors, and outer disciples may climb only three. The top floor's door has a bronze lock gone green in the keyhole. As you come near, the token on your chest flares, and a very sleepy voice: "…Nine cauldrons… divine elixir…" Then nothing.

line.zh: 外门后院的柴房，挨着伙房和猪圈。外门也有柴堆——你觉得这是缘分。
line.en: The woodshed behind the outer court, by the kitchen and the pigsty. The outer court has a woodpile too — you call that fate.

line.zh: 药园一片银白。最里面那株最贵的紫玉参旁边，夜里常有「咔嚓、咔嚓」的声音。园门上挂着一块牌子：药园重地，偷者必究。
line.en: The herb garden lies silver-white. Beside the costliest purple jade ginseng at the far end, at night, there is often a crunch, crunch. A board on the gate: Herb garden. Thieves will be pursued.

line.zh: 后山崖顶，一块比人还高的大青石。往下看是泗水，泗水再往北，是蒙山。
line.en: The cliff top behind the temple, a blue boulder taller than a person. Below runs the Si; north of the Si, Mount Meng.

line.zh: 山脚的坊市，一条街，卖符纸的、卖灵草的、卖萝卜的。钱掌柜的铺子最大，算盘打得最响。
line.en: The market at the foot of the mountain: one street of talisman paper, spirit herbs and radishes. Shopkeeper Qian's is the biggest stall, and his abacus the loudest.

name.en: The hidden realm · The stone door

line.zh: 泗水底下有一道石门。每十年，泗水退一次潮，露出它来。沉鼎观的名字，就是从这里来的。
line.en: Under the Si there is a stone door. Once every ten years the river draws back and shows it. Chending Temple takes its name from it.
